Report sent to team-lead.

**Findings: six real omissions, roughly 12,600 lines of uncovered code.**

Method was a literal name match against the inventory. Of 102 route files, 2 are unmatched; of 88 lib files, 4. I added rows S29–S34 for them. I also confirmed `routes/webhooks/**` is genuinely covered. The common cause: boundaries enumerate files by name, so anything whose name never surfaced ended up with no owner.
